mentions.name: Simple CRM
mentions.description: A simple CRM in early development, drawing on the author's experience implementing CRMs and heavily customizing an ERP, aimed at the 90% of companies that only need something basic rather than a heavyweight suite; the author plans to share it for feedback when finished.
mentions.problem: Off-the-shelf CRMs and heavily customized ERPs are bad, while 90% of companies only need something simple.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building this right now! I've helped several companies implement CRMs and worked on heavily customizing my ERP at work. They all suck, bad. 90% of companies only need something simple.
mentions.author: skrig
